name: Akita

flag.description: A white emblem on a dark red field: the katakana ア (a) stretched into a swoosh with a dot.
flag.symbolism: ア is the first sound of Akita, drawn in motion to show the prefecture leaping ahead.

hook: Akita's white swoosh on dark red is a katakana ア (a), for Akita, tipped on its side with a ball at the end.
trivia: The Akita dog breed comes from the prefecture's mountains.
Lake Tazawa, at 423 m, is the deepest lake in Japan.
